name: compartment
description: Encrypted, fully offline memory for Claude: one vault on your machine, shared with every MCP client. No network, no API key.
long_description:
Compartment is persistent memory for AI agents, stored on your own computer and encrypted at rest. What Claude learns in one conversation is available in every later one, and to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw and any other MCP client on the same machine. Nothing leaves it: the embedding model runs locally, the server speaks stdio only and opens no ports, and there is no account.

**Before the first run**, create the vault once in a terminal: `pip install compartment && compartment init` (or `pipx install compartment`, or `uv tool install compartment`). It asks for a passphrase you choose; that passphrase is the only key and Compartment cannot recover it. If the vault is locked after a restart, run `compartment unlock`.

If you already connected Claude Desktop with `compartment integrate claude` or the app's Connect button, you do not need this extension as well: both would start the same server and Claude would see every tool twice.

tools.name: memory_store
tools.description: Save one claim to the encrypted memory, with its source and date.

tools.name: memory_store_many
tools.description: Save several separate facts in one call, one memory each.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Recall from memory before answering: hybrid vector and keyword search.

tools.name: memory_link
tools.description: Record a relationship between two entities in the memory graph.

tools.name: memory_relations
tools.description: Query the memory graph, optionally as of a date.

tools.name: memory_unlink
tools.description: Remove one relation from the memory graph.

tools.name: memory_forget
tools.description: Delete a memory, optionally crypto-shredding it.

tools.name: memory_list_namespaces
tools.description: List namespaces and their record counts.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: Vault status: lock state, counts, model, index.

tools.name: memory_selftest
tools.description: Health check against the built-in reference facts.

tools.name: memory_lock
tools.description: Panic lock: seal the vault and drop the key now.

tools.name: memory_unlock
tools.description: Unlock from the agent; disabled unless the vault config enables it.
